# Requirements Checklist: SPEC-0007 Admin/Agent CRUD, Security-Day Gate, Public Site, and Professional UI Theme

**Purpose**: Verify the SPEC-0007 specification covers all requirements for Phase 3 items 8-9 (agent/admin CRUD, security-day gate admin-only, public site parity, professional UI theme) before implementation.
**Created**: 2026-08-17
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements. All items verified against the remediated spec (post-analyze) on 2026-08-17.

## Agent/Admin CRUD

- [x] CHK001 FR-001: `adm`/`su` can create agent records (name, contact details, credentials link) — spec §9 FR-001, §15 `POST /api/v1/agents`, BR-009
- [x] CHK002 FR-002: `adm`/`su` can view agent records (list + detail) — spec §9 FR-002, §15 `GET /api/v1/agents`
- [x] CHK003 FR-003: `adm`/`su` can update agent records — spec §9 FR-003, §15 `PUT /api/v1/agents/{id}`
- [x] CHK004 FR-004: agent records with business data are deactivated, not deleted; unreferenced records may be deleted — spec §9 FR-004, §12 mechanism, BR-006
- [x] CHK005 FR-005: `adm`/`emp` can create user accounts with role whitelist (`adm`,`emp`,`agt`,`guest`); `su` never settable via this path — spec §9 FR-005, §15 `POST /api/v1/admin/users`
- [x] CHK006 FR-006: only `su` can create `su` accounts (audited) — spec §9 FR-006, §15 `POST /api/v1/admin/superusers`
- [x] CHK007 FR-007: deactivating a user whose role is `su` requires `su` — spec §9 FR-007, §15 `POST /api/v1/admin/users/{id}/deactivate`
- [x] CHK008 BR-001: role matrix per §4.2 enforced server-side, not display-only — spec §10 BR-001, §12
- [x] CHK009 BR-006: agent records referenced by business data are deactivated, never deleted — spec §10 BR-006

## Security-Day Gate

- [x] CHK010 FR-008: `adm`/`su` can open and close the working day — spec §9 FR-008, §15, T022-T026
- [x] CHK011 FR-009: `emp` logins blocked on closed days (existing SPEC-0005 gate rule reused) — spec §9 FR-009, BR-002
- [x] CHK012 BR-002: gate rule — `emp` allowed only when `security` row exists with `closingtime IS NULL` — spec §10 BR-002
- [x] CHK013 BR-003: open/close day is `adm`/`su` only (replaces anonymous legacy `openForDay.asp`/`closeForDay.asp`); atomic per date, concurrent losers get 409 — spec §10 BR-003 (CHK022)
